༄༅/ /zhi byed lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i phrin las 'byung 'khrugs nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhi byed lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i phrin las 'byung 'khrugs nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog ces bya ba bzhugs so/

/rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa sogs/ /las dang rkyen las gyur pa yi/ /nad sel spyan ma la btud de/ /de yi sgrub thabs spel bar bya/ de la zhi byed lha mo bdun gyi nang tshan lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i phrin las btang ba la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po yo byad kyi gshom ni/ dbang bskur/ sogs dang 'brel na dbang chog nas bshad pa ltar bya dgos la/ spyi tsam du gtsang ma'i stegs dkar po'i steng rin po che'i snod du gtor ma dkar zlum rgyan ldan dkar gsum gyi bza' bcas bskor ba bzhag /chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar du bsham/ bum sgrub dgos na bum pa nyer lnga'i rdzas dri'i chus gang ba/ mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan gzungs rdor bcas pa stegs kyi dbus su bkod/ las bum mam bsang chu/ bgegs gtor/ nyer mkho rnams spyi ltar 'du bya/ cho ga la 'jug pa'i thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon tu 'gro bas brgyud 'debs btang*/ de nas sngon 'gro'i rim pa lnga las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rig pa'i rgyal mo sangs rgyas spyan ma la dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtshos bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ na mo: phyogs bcu dus bzhir bzhugs pa yi: skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho la: bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun: mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ bdag gzhan mi mthun zhi ba dang : byang chub go 'phang myur thob phyir: sgo gsum lha sngags ting 'dzin gyi: ye shes bsgrub par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ gtor ma/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i snod rnams su khaṃ las gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa so so'i spyod yul bzhin tu 'char bar gyur/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin brlab/

sarba bighnān ā karṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron 'gugs/ sarba bighnā na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ gṛhṇa daṃ ba lyā di swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum bsngo/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: rnal 'byor sgrub la bar gcod kun: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: 'das na rdul bzhin brlag par 'gyur: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang yungs thun gu gul dud pa rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bskrad/ bzhi pa srung mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: mi phyed rdo rje'i gur gyis gtams: ye shes me yis kun tu khyab: 'khrul rtog bag chags mtshams bcad do: oṃ badzra dzñā na rakṣa bhrūm̐ āḥ lnga pa gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: gnas yul dag pa'i zhing khams cher: dngos gsham yid sprul 'dod yon tshogs: kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ badzra sa manta bha dra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim la lnga las/ dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ aḥ stong pa nyid dang snying rje che: zung 'jug rig rtsal oṃ dkar po: de nyid yongs gyur skad cig gis: padma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng : sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa ni: skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas utpa la: 'khor lo spyan gyis mtshan pa bsnams: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: shin tu zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams: zhabs zung sems ma'i skyil krung bzhugs: nad kyi gdung ba kun sel ba'i: zla ba bdud rtsi'i 'od zer 'phro: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlabs: thugs nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med thim: gnyis pa ye shes pa bskul ba ni:

oṃ ye shes dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : snying rjes gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa: rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can: sngon gyi thugs dam dgyes dgongs nas: gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol: lus ngag yid la byin gyis rlobs: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang : dngos grub ma lus deng 'dir stsol: oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa na sarba artha sā dha na swā hā: sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi: badzra sa mā dza: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+wam̐: bstims nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: tshad med bzhi ldan phyag rgya ches: dgug gzhug bcings shing dgyes pa'i lha: rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang : thugs rje'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dzñā na sa ma ya ā sa na tiṣṭha hoḥ gsum pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs nas: ye shes bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: sku gang sgrib dag rigs kyi bdag: rnam par snang mdzad dbur brgyan gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra ta st+waṃ a haṃḥ /bzhi pa phyag dang mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa'i sprin dang bstod pa'i glu dbyangs phul bas dgyes par bsams la/ hoḥ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba che: yon tan phrin las bsam mi khyab: ye shes rig pa'i lha mo la: gus shing gdung bas phyag bgyi'o: a ti pu hoḥ pra tī tstsha hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis sprul: dpag yas nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter: rab 'byams mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra dzñā na arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidyā shapda sarba pū dza sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ: rdo rje'i sku ni mkha' ltar khyab: tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis khams gsum snang : 'od gsal thugs rjes 'gro kun sgrol: yon tan mi zad rgyan du rdzogs: phrin las sgyu 'phrul rol mo'i sprin:

'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun sel zhing : mchog thun dngos grub char chen 'bebs: rig pa'i lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod: lnga pa dzab bzla ba la gnyis las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ thugs kar bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi: zla steng oṃ mthar sngags kyis bskor: 'od 'phros bde gshegs rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs bdag la thim par gyur: oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa na sarba artha sā dha na swā hā: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas bsnyen pa'o: slar yang sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: thugs srog sngags phreng bcas pa las: 'od zer bdud rtsi'i char du babs: rang gzhan lus kyi nang kun gang : rgyu 'bras nad kun zhi bar bsam: oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa na sarba artha sā dha na sarba ro ga pra sha ma na ya swā hā: 'bum phrag gcig bzlas 'grub par 'gyur: bzlas pa grub nas mchod bstod gtor 'bul sogs rjes kyi las rim la 'jug go /dbang sgrub la mdun bskyed dgos pas bshad ma thag pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa grub nas/ slar mdun dkyil sogs la dmigs te dam tshig pa bskyed pa nas bzung gong gi phrin las bskyar la mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar bya/ yang dbang dang khrus kyi ched du bum sgrub byed na/ oṃ swa bhā wa sarba dharma bi shuddho3haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng : bhrūm̐ las rin chen bum pa ni: yangs shing rgya che mtshan nyid rdzogs: lha yi chu bo dal 'gro dang : rdzas kyi bcud ldan bdud rtsir 'khyil: kha rgyan mgul chings gos kyis brgyan: de dbus pad zla'i gdan gyi steng : sa bon yongs gyur skad cig gis: sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar: sogs dam tshig pa bskyed pa nas/ mchod bstod rdzogs kyi bar phrin las gong bzhin btang*/ bdag gi thugs srog sngags phreng las: rang 'dra gnyis pa bar med 'phros: bum lha'i thugs srog sngags bcas la: phog pas thugs dam rgyud bskul te:

'od zer dpag yas phyogs bcur 'phros: dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs kun: spyan drangs sa bon sngags phreng la: thim pas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs: bum pa yongs su gang ba yis: rig sngags nus pa'i bcud du gyur: ces dmigs shing gzungs thag blangs la bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams bzla/ mthar mchod bstod bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod yon phul bas bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i bcud du 'khyil te zhi byed kyi nus pa mchog dang ldan par gyur/ ces dmigs/ dbang dang las sbyor gang dgos skabs 'dir bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la'ang lnga las/ dang po mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i skabs su gong gsal mchod bstod bya/ dbang dang las sbyor rjes su mchod kha gsos la byin rlabs dang mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum/ gyis byin gyis brlab/ bsnyen sngags sham du/ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta bhāñdza kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ sarba karma ku ru hoḥ lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ sngags tsam gyis mchod cing bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i gter chen po: ye shes rig pa'i lha mo ches: bzhes shig bde ba chen por rol: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: nad gdon 'jigs dang bar chad sogs: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang : 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: ces pas dgyes bzhin tu gnang ba stsol bar mos/ gnyis pa nongs bshags ni/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang : gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas: 'dir ni bgyi bar gang nongs pa:

de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs: zhes dang yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa gshegs bsdu ni/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel na de'i ye shes brten yod na brtan bzhugs spyi mthun bya/ rten med na gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag nyid lhar snang 'od gsal dbyings: zab zhi spros pa bral ba'i ngang : slar yang mkha' las 'ja' tshon ltar: rdo rje gsum gyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na badzra ātma ko3haṃḥ zhes bsdu ldangs bya/ bzhi pa dge bsngo ni/ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin mthus: 'gro kun 'jigs dang sdug bsngal zhi: yang dag ye shes snang ba rgyas: 'phags ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog: lnga pa shis brjod ni/ oṃ: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis: byin gyis rlobs pa'i bkra shis shog: yi dam dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyis: dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gis: phrin las mthar phyin bkra shis shog: 'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing : rtag tu dpal gnas bkra shis shog: ces brjod cing me tog 'thor ba dang rol mo'i sgra bsgrag pas dge legs su bya/ 'di yi phan yon dang las tshogs rnams gter gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang 'jam mgon rin po che'i gsung sangs rgyas spyan ma'i las byang nag 'gros bzhugs kyang lha mo so sor kha spo rgyu yig chung rdo rje'i gsung rnams bcos par phangs shing ma bcos na nyobs kyis dogs pas gud du phyung ste/ lha mo phyi ma rnams kyi sgrub thabs dang 'gros mthun par bsdeb pa po ni phun tshogs rnam rgyal lo// //
